purpose: Frozen player-tracking baseline contract before tracker tuning or RF-DETR promotion.

analytics_eligibility_proxy.purpose: Diagnostic scope only; does not change GameplayFilter or production policy.
analytics_eligibility_proxy.semantics: wide-view proxy for separating broadcast close-ups from frames suitable for multi-player analytics

primary_cross_video_units: unique track IDs per gameplay minute
unique track IDs per 1000 tracked observations
time_normalization.note: Frame-count metrics are retained for debugging, but FPS-normalized metrics are preferred for cross-video comparison.

measurable_without_player_identity_gt: frames where all player detections are untracked
team-label stability only with correct match context
court_xy continuity only with valid plausible homography
requires_targeted_ground_truth: true track fragmentation by physical player

baseline_findings.decision: Proceed with RF-DETR as a challenger under the same downstream tracking/evaluation contract; do not replace YOLO without measured improvement.

rules: Measure the baseline before tuning the tracker.
Change one variable at a time.
RF-DETR remains a challenger until it beats the baseline quantitatively.
Use FPS-normalized metrics for cross-video tracking comparisons.
Do not change P0 ball policies or promote ball reacquisition.
Do not introduce new evaluation videos.
